paragraphs.source_en: The lives of ashigaru warriors were desperately poor. If a girl received a new padded jacket when she turned seven, her companions would gaze at her with boundless envy and say, “How fortunate she is.” Oharu had been born into just such circumstances, and now the spirited blood of an ashigaru warrior was awakening within her.

paragraphs.source_zh: 足轻武士的生活非常贫苦，女儿长到七岁，如果能做一身新棉袄，同伴们便羡慕无比：“她真幸福。”阿春就是生于此种环境，如今，足轻武士之血气，在她的身体里苏醒了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Since our lord has given the order, what are we to do with her?” Okaede asked.

units.source_en: “Since our lord has given the order, what are we to do with her?”
units.source_zh: “既然大人有令，该怎么处置她？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “既然大人有令，该怎么处置她？”阿枫开口问道。

paragraphs.source_en: Before Lady Tahara could answer, Oharu cut in: “Our lord gave no such order.” Her voice was cold and filled with confidence. The mistress and her attendant could not help exchanging a flustered glance.

units.source_en: Before Lady Tahara could answer, Oharu cut in: “Our lord gave no such order.”
units.source_zh: 还没等田原夫人回答，阿春抢先说道：“大人没下命令。”

The mistress and her attendant could not help exchanging a flustered glance.

paragraphs.source_zh: 还没等田原夫人回答，阿春抢先说道：“大人没下命令。”她充满自信，声音冰冷。主仆二人不禁慌乱地对视了一眼。

paragraphs.source_en: “Then use our lord’s name as a pretext and kill me. Go on, kill me. It was our lord himself who wished me to visit Hachiya.”

units.source_zh: “就借大人之命杀了我吧，杀我吧。

units.source_en: It was our lord himself who wished me to visit Hachiya.”
units.source_zh: 我去看望八弥，正是大人的意思。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “就借大人之命杀了我吧，杀我吧。我去看望八弥，正是大人的意思。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Silence!” Okaede’s face turned ashen. If the matter came to light, Lady Tahara was plainly incapable of bearing the responsibility. Okaede’s face darkened to a livid hue, while contempt and disdain brought a flush to Oharu’s cheeks. She regarded the two women before her calmly.

paragraphs.source_zh: “住口！”阿枫脸色发青。如果事情败露，田原夫人显然没有承担责任的能力。阿枫脸色青紫，阿春却因为不屑和轻蔑，双颊泛红。她平静地看着眼前这两个人。

paragraphs.source_en: The sunlight was so dazzling as to be almost unbearable. From somewhere came the sound of singing…
